sloka: उदीक्षमाणा गगनं केचिन्नेत्रेषु ताडिताः।शरैर्विविशुरन्योन्यं पेतुश्च जगतीतले ।। ६.७३.५६ ।।
transliteration: udīkṣamāṇā gaganaṁ kecinnetreṣu tāḍitāḥ।śarairviviśuranyonyaṁ petuśca jagatītale ।। 6.73.56 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara troops saw only the sharp pointed arrows covering them. They could not see the enemy of Indra being concealed by magical power.
